sectorSummary.overview: Sales and collections improve at many developers, supported by established brands, sustenance sales and premium projects, while annuity portfolios continue to grow. The outlook remains mixed: several launch or profit milestones move out, and many annual targets require substantially stronger H2 delivery. Project-completion accounting and asset transactions make reported earnings less comparable with bookings.

trends.text: Sustenance sales from existing projects complement new launches and help maintain customer activity.
Developers continue to add land, redevelopment opportunities or new phases to support future launch pipelines.

tailwinds.text: Brand strength, premium positioning and differentiated products support sales or pricing.

headwinds.text: Approvals, launch schedules and construction timing keep a substantial share of planned sales or completions dependent on H2 execution.

opportunities.text: Office, retail and hospitality portfolios provide rental and operating-income opportunities alongside residential development.
Arvind raises its FY27 bookings forecast; Lodha expects to beat its profit-growth target, and Sobha expects at least 50% PAT growth.
Senior living remains an expanding focus for Ashiana, with further projects and launches planned.

risks.text: Deferred launches or milestones at Aditya Birla, Ashiana, Keystone, Lodha and Sunteck qualify the growth outlook.
Debt, construction spending and the conversion of sales into collections need monitoring before assuming free cash flow.
One-time gains and completion-based recognition can lift reported profit without establishing a recurring earnings run rate.

insights.text: Ashiana exceeds its H1 bookings expectation and Brigade delivers about 2.4 million sq ft of Q2 launches; their annual targets remain open.
Puravankara’s annual sales target includes the Zentech monetization, while DLF total income includes a valuation gain.
Phoenix reports broad mall consumption growth without new operational retail area, and Max Estates’ quarterly residential sales are entirely from sustenance.
